Pink Gin

Pink Gin is a cocktail made fashionable in England in the mid-19th century, consisting of Plymouth gin and a dash of 'pink' Angostura bitters...

Main alcohol: Gin

Ingredients: One part Plymouth gin, Dash of Angostura Bitters

Preparation: Chill the glass, then coat the inside with the Bitters. Add the gin very well chilled, garnish and serve.

Served: Straight up; without ice
